nodes.label: attachDragHandle
nodes.rationale: Resize handle drag: snapping against getSnapPoints/snapX with threshold = dayWidth*0.4, live-updates the SVG bar while dragging, then persists via store.updateTask and pushes an undo/redo pair through plugin.pushUndo; on failure the bar is reverted and a Notice shown. Both sides call scheduleAfterChange after the write.

nodes.label: attachBarMove
nodes.rationale: Whole-bar move drag using an SVG translate transform on the bar group; identical save/undo/redo/scheduleAfterChange protocol to attachDragHandle.

nodes.label: DragState
nodes.rationale: Shared mutable drag state held by GanttView and threaded into renderers and drag handlers via RendererContext; carries active drag task, side, original x/width and a dragMoved flag used to suppress click-after-drag.
